Ele decide sozinho quando a resposta pre: Claude decides on its own when the answer needs something current, and shows the sources. Each search costs $0.01 on top of the tokens. In a chat, the Web button turns it off just there.

Se o filtro de segurança recusar um pedi: If the safety filter refuses a normal request by mistake, Anthropic tries again with another model it picks. Does not apply to Haiku.
Quando a API recusa um destes recursos p: When the API refuses one of these features for a model, Clave turns off just that feature and carries on. If Anthropic starts accepting it, turn it back on here.
O Clave soma o custo de cada resposta e: Clave adds up the cost of each reply and stops (or warns you) when the month reaches the cap. Max plan subscribers get monthly API credit ($100 on Max 5x, $200 on Max 20x): that amount makes a good cap.
De 1 a 28. Use o dia em que seu crédito: From 1 to 28. Use the day your credit renews.
Parar de responder até o mês virar: Stop replying until the month resets
Uma tarefa longa no Code pausa ao gastar: A long task in Code pauses after spending this much, and you decide whether to continue. 0 = no cap.
Para ter uma trava que nem o Clave conse: For a limit that not even Clave can get past, create a workspace with a spending limit in the Anthropic Console and use a key from it.
No modo Code o Claude trabalha numa past: In Code mode, Claude works in a folder on your computer: it reads, creates and edits files and runs commands.

Suas conversas, projetos e gastos ficam: Your chats, projects and spending are kept in a file inside Clave's dados/ folder, on this computer. Nothing goes anywhere else besides Anthropic itself (the messages you send).
O backup leva as conversas, os projetos: The backup includes chats, projects and spending history. Attached files and the key are not included.
Uma vez por dia, ao abrir. Nunca instala: Once a day, on startup. Never installs without you clicking.
O Clave é um app independente para usar: Clave is an independent app for using Claude through the Anthropic API, with your own key. It is not an Anthropic product and is not affiliated with Anthropic. "Claude" is a trademark of Anthropic.
Built with: marked, DOMPurify, highlight.js, KaTeX, the Source Serif 4 and IBM Plex fonts, the official Anthropic SDK for Python and Electron. The licenses are in the app/vendor folder.
